entry.title: Trustworthy Autonomy
entry.summary: Trust is not a personality trait of the model. It is a property of the system surrounding it.

entry.title: What does “good” mean for an agent?
entry.summary: AI exposes how much of quality was previously implicit infrastructure.

entry.title: The Agent Harness Is the Product
entry.summary: The model supplies general intelligence. The harness turns that intelligence into dependable work in a particular world.

entry.title: Skills aren’t policies
entry.summary: Procedure, authority, and enforcement are different concerns.

entry.title: Memory should accumulate judgment
entry.summary: Transcripts preserve history. Useful memory changes the next decision.

entry.title: Rollouts Are Decision Problems
entry.summary: A rollout reviewer should not merely detect anomalies. It should decide what the available evidence justifies doing next.

entry.title: Context engineering vs. harness engineering
entry.summary: Context makes the world legible; the harness makes action dependable.

entry.title: Why agent verifiers fail
entry.summary: A second model does not automatically create independent assurance.
